extraction.Name: Charles Arcoren
extraction.Refused/Protested: issuance of fee patents to Indians without the request of the patentee
extraction.NOTES: Letter dated July 5, 1929, from E. E. McKean, Superintendent, Rosebud, South Dakota, to the Commissioner of Indian Affairs. References a former report made June 22nd. An affidavit of Charles Arcoren is enclosed. Ella McHenry is mentioned in the affidavit but her whereabouts are unknown. Clement Valandra is described as a Rosebud Indian who has nothing financially and a statement from him would not be of value. Reference made to cases of Charles and Luther, with note that there should be something on file in the Office concerning their case. File reference: 5-1142.
